inspection: Current site uses /explore search cards and Astro player props. The selector still requests /api/player-servers but its own client falls back to a bundled server list when that endpoint fails.
repairs: Follow advertised same-origin watch cards matching title/year and the requested movie/TV type.
Require exact TMDB identity in the matching player component before using the published embed.
For TV, expand only the active published server template with the requested season/episode.
Parse inert JSON attributes; do not execute downloaded website JavaScript.
capturedPageChecks: Actual Inception (2010), TMDB 27205 search/detail HTML reaches its published movie player through the existing loader.
Actual Modern Family, TMDB 1421 player config expands the requested season 2 episode 3 exactly.

validation.cases: Matching versus conflicting TMDB identity, same-title alternatives, same-origin watch cards, movie/series isolation, inactive/malformed props, unknown template fields and exact TV substitution.

limitations: Only the current page-selected server is restored; complete enumeration of the selector fallback list remains unresolved.
Published player links are extraction evidence, not decoded playback.
next: Run the Android movie/series evidence audit and review correct content, sustained audio, runtime, smoothness and seeking. Keep certification pending.
